title.narrative: Strengthening and Fostering Enabling Environment for Whistleblowers in the EU (SAFE for Whistleblowers)

description.narrative: This project will support an enabling environment for the protection of whistleblowers. It will contribute to enhancing transparency and accountability, the enforcement of the national law, the application of the EU Charter for Fundamental Rights, and ultimately to strengthening the protection of EU values and respect for the rule of law. The project is part of the European Commission's Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values programme (CERV). Countries involved are Czech Republic, France, Ireland, Lithuania, Netherlands, Portugal, and Slovakia. An external partner involved is MLA in France. Value of the contract is EUR 951,058.
